description: This Java class, PrefixedActorNameFactory, generates prefixed actor names for Akka actors, ensuring unique names by appending a counter encoded in base64. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.akka package and interacts with Akka utilities for name creation.

classes.name: PrefixedActorNameFactory
classes.description: A thread-safe factory class for generating uniquely prefixed actor names using an internal counter.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate PrefixedActorNameFactory with a specified prefix.

methods.name: createActorName
methods.description: Generates a new actor name by combining the prefix, separator, and a base64-encoded counter value.
